summary_alerts.html:
CONSENSUS SELL — WAT (Dingell (D) + Jr (R), cross-party)
2 members, combined disclosed value ~$16K. The cross-party pairing is modest in dollar size but notable because two members on opposite sides of the aisle trimmed the same life-sciences instrumentation name within the same window, which may reflect shared concerns about near-term demand in biotech capex or a reaction to sector-level guidance rather than a partisan policy view.
